card.name: Plant description lists in Flora entries
card.fires_on: Commas and growth-form words (herbs, vines, shrubs, tree) in the opening line of botanical plant descriptions, especially 'Description from Flora of China'.

modes.label: Comma after growth form
modes.description: Comma following a plant habit term at the start of a botanical description.
modes.example: Description from Flora of China Herbs<<,>> annual or perennial, all parts strongly aromatic

modes.label: Growth-form word itself
modes.description: Habit words such as shrubs, vines or tree inside a plant description.
modes.example: Description from Flora of China Shr<<ubs>> or trees, deciduous; buds conspicuous

card.plain: It fires on the first lines of plant descriptions that list whether a plant is a herb, vine, shrub or tree.
